signals.title: Vibration rising toward alarm
signals.summary: Daily mean vibration rose from 1.80 to 3.97 mm/s RMS over three weeks; the alarm is 4.5. Bearing temperature rose from 61 to 67 degC.

evidence.description: Vibration up for three weeks, below alarm
Lubrication in August; bearings not replaced

signals.title: Seal failures recurring every 16 days
signals.summary: 3 seal failures since Aug 16, each recorded as flush line contamination. If the 16-day interval holds, the next falls near Oct 3. Seal flush pressure is declining again.

evidence.description: Flush pressure drops before each failure
Flush line inspection open, awaiting scaffold

signals.title: Fouling signature on feed preheat
signals.summary: Differential pressure rose from 8.1 to 20.9 psi while heat duty fell from 12.0 to 8.0 MW; the low duty alarm is 7 MW.

evidence.description: Heat duty approaching its low alarm

signals.title: Seal repair claimed but not recorded
signals.summary: Handover note N-005 says the seal was replaced, but linked order WO-0005 is cancelled. The repair is unverified.
